reasons.requirements: The spec and diff cover all seven acceptance criteria, including the PATCH missing-versus-null distinction, UTC overdue rules and the exact UI texts.
reasons.scope: The code changes stay on the ticket; the only extras are the spec and plan documents added under docs/, and the extra overdue=false filter, which the approved spec asks for.
reasons.tests: Store, API and prerender tests are thorough and no existing tests were weakened; the interactive checkbox filtering and the page's toggle behaviour have no automated test, only manual Playwright runs.
reasons.conventions: The change follows the ValidationException pattern, data-testid usage, TDD and adds no new packages; it does not update the AGENTS.md locators list for the new test IDs.
reasons.architecture: Validation, overdue computation and filtering all live in TodoStore, the page and API reuse List(overdue), and the clock is injected through TimeProvider.
reasons.codeQuality: The code is clean and atomic, validating before it mutates, but the HasDueDate flag set inside an init setter is slightly subtle, and Todo carries a computed IsOverdue init property that every snapshot has to populate.
